svg.title: Request Coalescing, Single Execution Task and Retries

g.text: Request Coalescing, Single Execution Task and Retries
merge only; the wait is not restarted and no second task is created
create one task that waits 600 ms
later events during the wait only merge
same connectionID → clear the coalescing handle
the caller awaits the same syncTask.value
reuse the existing task, or create the only one
[connection valid, same generation, not cancelled; another round only for new events]
take this round's request; clear pending work
Connection / cancellation re-checked before each domain.
Preferences and login refreshes may write back.
new events may arrive while waiting on I/O
connection invalidated; clear lists / pending work / tasks
note whether new events arrived, then merge retryRequest
[no new events (even with failed work pending)]
this round ends; failures wait for a later event or periodic wake-up
the same task takes the next round; no parallel transaction
defer: only the current connection may clear its own syncTask
Finishing the execution task does not maintain the periodic task.
After a connection change, a returning old task must not overwrite
the new task's handle or results.
